I'm trying to understand why the end-to-end delay when sending just one packet over N links is NLR.

When there are multiple packets of interest, the equation is (n+p-1) x  L/R, which makes sense since the result will be in units of seconds, which is appropriate for describing delay. However, NLR results in units of bit^2/second doesn't it? Why multiply N by LR instead of L/R?
